c4isr_products.name: Raft Data Platform (RDP)
c4isr_products.description: FACT: Raft publishes an RDP SDK family (Python, Go, Java/Kotlin, C/C++, TypeScript) on GitHub (repos created June-July 2026, releases tagged Sept 2026) that talks to an RDP server over ConnectRPC/gRPC using protobuf services generated from a Buf module 'raft/wdm' (object_service.search_objects etc.), with API-key, OAuth2 client-credentials or bearer auth, TLS, and a developer portal at developer.teamraft.com. Python package is Alpha status (Development Status 3). INFERENCE: RDP is the productized form of the real-time DoD data platform described in Raft's 2024 job postings (aggregating 750+ sensors, >1B events/day, millisecond latency, presented as a common operational picture) built on Kafka/Kafka Streams/Flink/Apache Pinot/Java/Scala/Kubernetes. Study scratchpad (S08, from MeriTalk 2026-06-23 mirror) records Raft supplying data/services registries, transformation and federation inside the Army NGC2 common data-layer baseline led by Anduril with Palantir.
c4isr_products.input_process_output_user: INPUT: sensor and system feeds (hundreds of heterogeneous sensors; NGC2 partner application data). PROCESS: streaming ingest, enrichment, registry/catalog of data and services, transformation between schemas, federation across nodes, queryable store. OUTPUT: COP-ready object/track data served via RDP APIs/SDKs to C2 applications and dashboards. USER: air-domain-awareness and command-post operators (DoD), NGC2 division/brigade staffs via partner apps (INFERENCE).

c4isr_products.name: GeoSet
c4isr_products.description: FACT: Open-source fork of Apache Superset (repo created 2026-01-16) adding native PostGIS geometry support and deck.gl map layers, plus a hardened RHEL-8 image with 0 critical CVEs for high-security environments.
c4isr_products.input_process_output_user: INPUT: PostGIS-stored points/lines/polygons. PROCESS: SQL/BI layer with geospatial chart plugins. OUTPUT: multilayer map dashboards, lasso-select exports. USER: analysts building geospatial dashboards in restricted environments.

companies.apis_sdks_open_interfaces: No public developer API, SDK or documentation surface (api-evangelist, 2026-07). Open-source: ffmpeg-framer (gRPC Framer interface, Go) and vue-easy-grid (UI library). INFERENCE: gRPC-based plugin interfaces exist for sensor/video ingestion.
companies.security_classification_requirements: Public evidence insufficient on IL/ATO; products marketed as fully functional in contested/disconnected environments; Army Intelligence Enterprise work implies classified handling (INFERENCE).
companies.technical_differentiator: Operator-trainable ('do-it-yourself') edge computer vision with persistent tracking that runs without cloud, packaged with a comms-resilient command layer; validated by soldier evaluations and backed by an Army IDIQ - claims company-sourced.
companies.suspected_moat: Army IDIQ vehicle plus field-embedded engineering; Edgeworks lab as a customer-facing validation channel; edge-AI pipeline IP. MEDIUM-LOW (edge CV is competitive).
major_competitors: Scale AI, Vannevar Labs, Rebellion Defense-era edge AI
companies.obvious_weaknesses: IDIQ ceiling far exceeds any disclosed obligation; no public API/SDK reduces ecosystem leverage; small public footprint; concentration on U.S. Army; relocation and rapid hiring add execution risk.
companies.evidence_user_adoption: Soldier validation cited by company (MEDIUM-LOW); hiring of field engineers (INFERENCE of fielding).
companies.evidence_repeat_procurement: Air Force SBIR (2022) followed by Army IDIQ (2025) and a further Army award (2026) - cross-service repeat interest, MEDIUM.
companies.evidence_prototype_to_production: IDIQ 'deliver and demonstrate' language and JIO 'accelerate fielding' suggest transition in progress; no production quantities disclosed. MEDIUM-LOW.
companies.tech_stack_inference_from_jobs: INFERENCE (repos and job titles): Go and gRPC microservices (ffmpeg-framer), ffmpeg video pipelines, Vue 3/TypeScript front end (vue-easy-grid), on-device ML inference; roles emphasize field engineering rather than cloud.
